test_meter_update_and_reset: test a meter by applying updates, checking values, resetting, and reapplying the same updates
test_meter_distributed_sync: test distributed meter synchronization across two processes using multiprocessing queues and torch distributed
test_meter_classy_state_transfer: test get and set classy state methods by transferring state between two meters and verifying values match
test_meter_invalid_inputs: test that a meter raises AssertionError when given invalid model output or target shapes
spawn_meter_worker_process: spawn a meter worker process that listens for update, value, and shutdown signals via queues
